summary: Five Below filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, announcing Q2 fiscal 2026 results and a new $600 million share repurchase program approved by the Board on August 29, 2026, replacing the prior program from November 2023. The buyback has no fixed expiration and repurchases will be at management's discretion, via open-market or private transactions under Rule 10b-18. Q2 net sales rose 22.9% to $1.3 billion, comps up 14.1%, GAAP EPS $3.99, adjusted EPS $1.68. Watch for execution pace and balance-sheet impact.
